data.translation: Die Brüder und die Unholde, mit denen sie kämpften, hatten gerade eine Kampfpause gemacht. Er hatte gesagt: Wer meinen Grußer widert, dem werde ich helfen. - Die sieben Brüder des Mädchens hatten seinen Gruß erwidert. Es war in diesem Augenblick friede, kein Krieg.

rationale: Adds past ongoing combat contextualized by the truce.

summary: Sense 1: revise the gloss
rationale: The baseline already includes bloody combat (24/173), sword-and-lance warfare (29/43), and war against the Turks. New narratives confirm that armed combat belongs to the existing sense rather than a separate one.

summary: All 45 occurrences were checked as qtl II, distinct from emphatic qṭl killing; Turoyo Stem II follows the glossary despite the Arabic etymon's Stem III.

Reciprocal participants can form a plural subject, a subject plus ʕam opponent, or coordinated l-marked expressions. PrS 1/64 and 85/51 have singular-looking mqatele with two l-marked participants; retain the surface form without silently imposing plural morphology.

In PrS 3/14 bi walaye d Diyarbekər is a location, despite German 'gegen die Stadt'. In PrS 35/27 four months accompanies ongoing k-Infectum; in 96/262 Infectum-wa backgrounds the fighting before a truce.
m-less qatalle/qatelu/qatəl is already represented by baseline (m)qatalle and the Imperativ. It is not a new stem or new box. qatelan adds a distinct first-person suffix question.
Existing 24/173, 29/43, prs 89/13 and prs 137/15 passages were not duplicated. No new numbered sense or idiom is justified; the only gloss change clarifies the already attested breadth of sense 1.
Jan Beṯ-Şawoce: the supplied English is project machine translation. All semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo; English quotations are retained verbatim and are not edition translations.
No new numbered sense is justified: round 1 already proposes streiten, kämpfen, Krieg führen. qtl II remains distinct from qṭl killing, even where both appear in one report (Jan 2.27/4504).
The new Preterit-wa mqatewolən contrasts with recurrent mqatliwo and completed mqatalle. Root-l reduction before -wo does not define a separate stem.

Jan 2.22/4013 mqatewolan is ambiguous between first-plural agent and suffixal opponent coding; avoid a definitive alignment claim. Explicit group coordination in Mqatelan aḥna w hənne independently supports reciprocal plurality.
The collection includes historical warfare, factional quarrels, personified waves and public causes. Ordinary purpose or new participants alone do not establish separate lexical senses.
Confirm mqatela mm... in MAC NE Dilo and Falako/9 as an abandoned feminine Infectum or a different false start; only its complete mqatlowa reformulation is quoted.
Does singular-looking mqatele with two l-marked participants have default agreement, or is the second l- phrase a differently coded opponent? Compare PrS 1/64 and 85/51.
Confirm qatelan (PrS 45/22) as m-less first-person plural Preterit; is ləno w l aḥuni an explanatory participant phrase?
Collate old prs 89/13 and 137/15 with PrS 35/2 and 49/11 before changing references. The inherited translation at 78/115 ends with '(731'; check the original reference boundary before repairing it.
Confirm segmentation and participant coding of mqatewolan in Jan 2.22/4013, especially -lan relative to six men; compare Preterit-wa mqatewolən (1.39/1745; 2.27/4497).
Does mqatəl lašana in Jan 4.I/552 allow specifically nonviolent campaigning? The supplied Turoyo alone does not establish that distinction.
